summary: 40 proposals judged: 33 PASS, 7 FAIL. No fabricated quotes; two evidence items are honest paraphrases of frontmatter (the Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency retypes), not verbatim. Most cuts hold, because most of these links have nothing behind them but the label. The failures fall into three groups. First, stale premises: the readers worked from the pre-fold link list, so 'the pair already carries X' was sometimes false after the fold step (Swarm Weave to Pages as Agents now has only the deepens they would cut; the BBS, SUBSTRATE and oscillator reasons cite links that are gone or sit on the other page), and two proposals in the same set (10 and 21) cut both sides of the Spinoza Conatus and Quality Manifesto mirror, which would erase a real pair. Second, cuts where a sentence does exist (Loudon's Toolkit's 'Spinozist conatus' bullet; Excellent Adventure as the method the hub grew from), and both should be retypes instead. Third, the monism pages (Bessel, Wallpaper Groups, Categorizing Inharmonicity) were retyped to exemplifies a hub whose principle is conatus, not monism; their true ground is People/Spinoza.md. Before applying, re-read the post-fold frontmatter, not the room list.
